greeting: Gabi, you came home! Everyone's here, even the people nobody invited.
I'm fine, by the way, just a little damp. I've been damp since the pool. Don't look at my eyes, they're doing a thing.
phaseIntro: You play chess on your phone. I play chess with the living room.
The pieces are life-size, and some of them are the neighbors. Your move, Goblet.
phaseWin: Okay, checkmate. That was low key sigma, for a guy who's still alive.
Take the candle. Mami's next and she wants a hug so bad. Like, SO bad.
phaseLose: Checkmate. Massive L. Your rating's going down AND you're about to be lunch.
afterFight: The cake's on the table. Or we run it back, I've got nothing but time now.
drawOffer: Wait, WAIT. Let's be mature about this.
I'll offer you a draw. Come closer and shake on it.
drawAccepted: You took the DRAW? Bro, you shook my hand and it came off. Then I bit you a little.
Skill issue. Set the pieces up again.

greeting: Mijo, come here. I have been standing next to this cake since four o'clock, and I have not blinked once.
You walked the whole town in those shoes? Come give your mother a hug.
phaseIntro: We are not fighting, mijo. You know the rule in this house: no violent video games.
I say a word in Spanish, you tell me what it means. Every one is on a street sign, with my note under it. Then I hug you, very, very hard.
phaseWin: Ay, you got so fast. When did you get so fast?
Take the candle. Papi is next, and he has been practicing his jokes. Lo siento.
phaseLose: Ven aquí. Otra vez, mijo. I am not going anywhere. I will be right here, by the cake.
afterFight: We could go around again, mijo. Or we could all go to the pool. Everyone is going to the pool.

bossRef.taunt: No violent video games, mijo. Just a hug.

greeting: Gabi! You made it! I got Banshee running again for the occasion. I had some parts left over.
Your mother says no jokes at the dinner table. We are not at the dinner table.
phaseIntro: You don't have your permit, so I'm driving.
Three, two, one... hub's active. Get ready to groan, kiddo.
phaseWin: You tripped the main breaker. Just like Worlds, except this time I'm proud of it.
Here's the last candle from us. Take the cake to the pool, Gabi. Whatever came out of that drain, put it back.
phaseLose: Ha! Gotcha. Want to hear another one? You don't get a choice.
afterFight: The pool's that way, and everyone's following you. Don't look back, it only encourages them.

message: Happy sixteenth, Gabi. We love you.
credits: With love by Papi, and a great deal of fake blood.
